Class Staff

java.lang.Object
entity.Staff
Direct Known Subclasses:
Host, Waiter
public abstract class Staff extends Object
A member of staff who can do at most one action per turn.

Waiter extends this in Stage 1. Chef and Cashier can extend it too, if Danial agrees.

The "one action per turn" rule lives here once, so no subclass repeats it.
